notes.title: 1.1.1 Released
notes.content:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue which could corrupt saves if a piece was on an un-ownable tile when the save occurred.
[*] Updated Unity and libraries.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.1 Beta
notes.content:
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue which could corrupt saves if a piece was on an un-ownable tile when the save occurred.
[*] Updated Unity and libraries.
[/list]

[h3]How to Use the Beta[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Open the Properties window for Forgotten Souls in Steam.
[*] Click the Betas tab.
[*] Choose the 1.1.1 version.
[/olist]

You can revert to any previous version or the currently live version in the same way.
